first_words: At a hockey game, she spotted a strange mole
on the back of a man's neck
It was an odd color, and she thought it could be cancer
She was nervous about upsetting a stranger
So she typed a note in big letters on her phone
and pressed it against the glass
The team's equipment manager read the message
Still, he went to a doctor just in case
and when they checked the mole, they found cancer
He asked people to help him find the woman
and when she was finally identified
both teams surprised her with a ten thousand dollar scholarship
